list: The official 55 trophies, 2026-11-18, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles
note: Guides are written for this entry in its own words from the official descriptions and the published guides named beside each trophy. GTA VI details that no published guide has verified yet are marked unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own once the other 54 trophies are done, so there is nothing to do for this one directly. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then side strands and robberies, then the 100 percent completion push, then the odd one-offs. PowerPyx puts the whole run at roughly 200 hours and Push Square at 300 or more, so treat it as a long project, not a weekend. All 55 trophies are offline, so no online play is needed for any of them.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100 percent completion. After the final mission, open Progress, then Stats, then the 100 percent Completion checklist to see every remaining task — Push Square's guide lists the checklist in full. You do not need literally everything: for example, 15 of the 18 collectible card sets count, and 70 of the 80 challenges. PowerPyx estimates the whole platinum run at about 200 hours, and this trophy is most of that time.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps — GameMapa counts 397 stunt spots in total, so you have room to pick the easy ones. Stunts also feed the 100 percent checklist, which wants more than 250, so keep doing them past this trophy. Track progress under Progress, then Stats.

trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. GameMapa lists the nine types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. Dip into each one as it unlocks during the story — this is a sampler, not a mastery trophy, so one try of each is enough.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. GameMapa counts 42 challenges across 12 shooting ranges, and KeenGamer lists the same 42 as part of the 100 percent cleanup. Gold medals need accuracy and speed, so learn each layout on the easier weapon class first, then chase gold. This is one of the longer skill trophies, so leave it for the post-story phase when you can retry freely.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. There are 18 meditation spots; KeenGamer flags this as the one potentially missable trophy, because one meditation — on a balcony, after the mission Down to Earth, with Lucia at Jason's house in the morning — is only available in Chapter 1. trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get a four-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and escape until the stars clear. Use a fast car and open roads, and stay away from roadblocks. It pops when the wanted level drops to zero with your partner beside you.

trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-aim ability — trigger it in a firefight with at least five enemies in view and drop five before it ends. trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The description is a melee drive-by — striking someone with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. GameMapa lists it among the five hidden trophies whose method is still unconfirmed, so the exact trigger is not verified; the working method is a melee drive-by knockdown. Marked unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are the dirty cash from robberies — launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is clean. Keep robbing and laundering through the story and the total adds up; this is a long grind, so start early.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spend $100,000 in total at shops — weapons, clothes, food, anything counts. It accumulates across the whole game, so normal spending during the story covers much of it; top up with big purchases in the cleanup phase.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage property in Leonida — the official list data counts eight. Garages store your vehicles, so buy them as you can afford them; the last one is usually the most expensive, so save for it.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app on the in-game phone and register ten vehicles to it. Any vehicles count — register the ones you drive most, and the trophy pops at ten.
